diagnostics.message: Node "screening" (pack "sanctions-screening"): This evaluation was refused because the project's configuration sets requireComparableFacts, and these facts have a JSON type the comparison that reads them can never match: "/screening/matches" is a number, and equals can match only a string; "/screening/matches" is a number, and greater-than-or-equal can match only a decimal string. There is no coercion between JSON types: across types, equals and in are false and not-equals is true whatever the value, and an ordered comparison is unknown. Send each fact in a type its comparison can match, or leave it out, which the pack reads as unknown.
